setting.deviceName: The name used to identify this device to trusted peers.
setting.codePath: Optional VS Code CLI path for the Worker Agent Host runtime. Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS arm64 are supported; the current installation is discovered automatically.
setting.peerDelegation: Enable same-device peer window discovery, policy configuration, and task tools. Enabled by default; disable to opt out. Incoming task reception and directional Workspace authorization remain default-deny.
setting.userDataDir: Override the current VS Code instance user-data directory for editor Agent Host discovery. Leave empty for automatic platform/product derivation.
setting.authenticationProviders: Maps an AHP protected-resource or authorization-server URL to a VS Code authentication provider ID and exact scopes. No provider or scope is inferred.
setting.capabilityTags: Capability tags published for newly registered workspaces. Paths and credentials must not be used as tags.
